title: Implement caliptra_mailbox_bridge.c: connect wolfSSL hook to libcaliptra
description: Create wolfcrypt/src/port/caliptra/sim/caliptra_mailbox_bridge.c. This is a thin shim that implements our wolfSSL caliptra_mailbox_exec(word32 cmd_id, const void *req, size_t req_len, void *resp, size_t resp_len) by calling libcaliptra's caliptra_mailbox_execute(uint32_t cmd, const struct caliptra_buffer *tx, struct caliptra_buffer *rx, bool async). Bridges the two slightly different signatures. Links against libcaliptra built from ~/caliptra/libcaliptra/.
